mutants.name: sequential-reads
mutants.why: replacing the thread pool with a plain loop makes tip reads sequential; three 0.5-s reads take 1.5 s, failing the <1.0-s concurrency assertion

mutants.name: short-circuit-on-unstaged
mutants.why: short-circuiting on any non-empty porcelain line (instead of only staged changes) makes the arm treat an initialized submodule's worktree advance (' M') as an uncommitted change, producing a false fail on the Air
